description: Ministry of Water Supply - Errata, Published On Page 3A under No. 10-423 Extra Gazette No. 2197/22 On 15.10.2020, Pathiragoda Udahamulla West
categorisation: The gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It specifically concerns the acquisition of servitude rights over a described parcel of land for a water supply project. The document includes a detailed legal description of the property (location, boundaries, extent) and addresses a correction to a previous land-related notice. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property matters.
